why: Round 1 review, Codex must-fix 2: five couplets. A five-character line answered by another five-character line ending in 。 satisfied the old 'has Chinese and runs past 8 characters' test, so 床前明月光 became a card whose meaning was 疑是地上霜。 The length ratio (a definition runs at least half again its term's length) is what refuses it: verse answers its own line one for one.
